title: /risk-center/risks page loads and renders the risk list without error
preconditions: Logged in as a user with risk.read
steps: Wait for the page to finish loading
expectedResult: Page renders the risk table/list with no unhandled error boundary, no perpetual spinner, and existing seeded risks (if any) are visible.

title: 'Add Risk Assessment' button opens the create-risk form
description: risk-center/risks/page.jsx wraps the 'Add Risk Assessment' menu button in PermissionHide permission="risk.create" and its handleCreateRisk() opens CreateRiskModal in 'create' mode. Covers the three sub-triggers (Manual / Cloud Resource / Security Finding Assessment) each opening the same modal.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with risk.create
steps: Click 'Manual Risk Assessment' from the dropdown
expectedResult: CreateRiskModal opens as a drawer/dialog in create mode with an empty risk form (name, description, category, riskType, likelihood/impact fields visible).

title: /risk-register/[id] detail page loads for an existing risk
preconditions: At least one risk exists in the active project
Logged in as a user with risk.read
steps: From /risk-center/risks, click into any risk row
Wait for the page to finish loading
expectedResult: Risk detail page renders with the risk's name, inherent/residual score, and phase visible — no unhandled error boundary or blank page.

title: /risk-center dashboard page loads without error
preconditions: Logged in as a user with risk.read
steps: Wait for the page to finish loading
expectedResult: Dashboard renders its widgets (heat map, top risks, governance summary) with no unhandled error boundary or perpetual spinner.

title: /risk-center/risk-triage page loads without error
preconditions: Logged in as a user with risk.read
steps: Wait for the page to finish loading
expectedResult: The module risk triage queue page renders (empty state or a list of pending candidates) with no unhandled error boundary.
